evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and directly modifies core logging and string utilities in src/logging.cpp and src/util/string.h.
rationale: Prevents untrusted input from forging arbitrary log lines in `debug.log`. As the PR demonstrates, callers and external inputs can inject fake errors or log lines that could mislead node operators or trigger false alarms in monitoring tools, making central newline escaping an important integrity fix for the logging subsystem.
